m: उप-√ ढौक् Caus. P. -ढौकयति, to fetch, bring, prepare; to offer, present, Hit. Comm. on KātyŚr. vii, 2, 2; Kāraṇḍ.
a: उपढौक् — Caus. 1 To present (as an offering), make a respectful offering; एकैकं पशुमुपढौकयामः H. 2. --2 To carry out, accomplish.

s: klI, (upa + QOka + lyuw .) pAritozikadravyam । Bew qAlA ityAdi BAzA । tatparyyAyaH । prABftam 1 pradeSanam 2 upAyanam 3 upagrAhyaH 4 upahAraH 5 upadA 6 । ityamaraH ॥
v: na॰ upa + QOka--BAve lyuw । 1 upahAre rAjAdeH saMtozArTaM dravyAdiprApaRe (BewadeoyA) karmmaRi lyuw । 2 upahriyamARe upAyanadravye ।
m: उप-ढौकन n. a respectful present (made to a king), L.
a: उपढौकनं — A respectful offering or present, Nazarānā.
